newsitem.title: CANADA: National Bank sets C$150 million debenture.
newsitem.headline: National Bank sets C$150 million debenture.

text.p: National Bank of Canada agreed with a syndicate of underwriters to issue C$150 million of 7.50 percent debentures due October 17, 2011, said lead underwriter Levesque Beaubien Geoffrion Inc on Monday.

Levesque is the majority-owned investment banking subsidiary of National Bank. The brokerage firm said the underwriters agreed to purchase the debentures at 99.12 percent of their principal amount, plus accrued interest if any from November 1.
The debentures, which will be dated November 1, 1996, will be offered to the public at prices to be negotiated with purchasers, Levesque said.
The brokerage said the purpose of the offering was to enlarge National Bank's Tier 2 capital base.

Levesque said National Bank would file a preliminary short-form prospectus regarding the debentures with securities regulators in each Canadian province and the Superintendent of Financial Institutions of Canada.
The offering was expected to close on November 1, 1996, Levesque said.

In addition to Levesque, RBC Dominion Securities Inc, Nesbitt Burns Inc, CIBC Wood Gundy Securities Inc, ScotiaMcLeod Inc, Goldman Sachs Canada, TD Securities Inc, Midland Walwyn Capital Inc, BLC Rousseau Inc, and Trilon Securities Corp will act as underwriters.
